_comment: Per-app CPU and memory alerts, applied by the hub on start (APP_ALERTS_CONFIG). Keys are system names; '*' is the default for every app. cpu is % of the whole host (as in the containers table), memory is GB, min is minutes over the limit before alerting. On an app, an omitted field inherits the default and 'disabled': true mutes it. Rules here are read-only in the UI; rules added in the UI are kept.

vienna-1._note: vienna-1 has 10 cores, so 20% is the old Grafana rule's two cores.

hammas-dev._note: 8 cores / 16 GB dev box with no Docker. Its agent runs with PROCESSES=true, so apps are process groups: a systemd service, or a program outside one, tagged with the user ('t3code (hammas)', 'bun (hammas)'). A versioned template unit ('cutroom-runner@0.20261117.6') is matched by its base name ('cutroom-runner (hammas)'). 25% is two cores. Limits sit above normal use and need 30 minutes over before alerting. 'bun (hammas)' is every tmux dev server summed. Generic shells and runtimes are not watched on their own.
